## History

Alexander Spencer is mentioned in connection to the adoption of an orphan from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) for [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Through his arrangements, an orphan girl is brought to the [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station instead of the boy the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) had anticipated. This mix-up leaves [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to collect the young girl and return her to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to resolve the error with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I.
